desc: FROM CARD: "BRASS TWEEZERS HUNG TO A ROUND BEADED CORD. THIS SPECIMEN WAS PRESENTED BY PERRI PA HOU EE AN ARAPAHO CHIEF, TO DR. F. KAUFF [sic, should be Kampf] [Las] VEGAS, N.MEX. NOTE THE TENT DESIGN ON THE TWEEZERS." "Tent design" consists of two triangles with crosses on top. Possibly could also represent a mission/church? Original list in accession file identifies as "Brass tweezers for extracting the hair. Presented by Perri-Pa-hoo-ee, a Chief of the Arapahoes, to Dr. F. Kampf, at Las Vegas, New Mexico." Rau acquired the tweezers from Kampf. Dr. F. (Ferdinand) Kampf was a civilian astronomer on the Wheeler Survey, 1873 - 1878 (his last season in the field ended in 1877).
